cohort: 451 pregnant women with cardiac disease (59 with moderate to high-risk disease) managed in a single maternity hospital.
finding: The study observed favourable outcomes with no venous thromboembolic events, a modest rate of post-partum haemorrhage (5%), and no maternal deaths in pregnant women with cardiac disease receiving multidisciplinary care.
followup_time: Up to the postnatal/post-partum period (exact duration not specified).
